title: Batlhokomedi ba Tshingwana
intro: Mo tshingwaneng e e tlhogang, morafe mongwe o ne wa dira maikano a a masisi. Mme boikemisetso jwa bone bo ne jwa lekwa fa thato ya bomodimo e ne e tsereganya, e fetola bontsi jwa bone go nna lefatshe le le senang sepe.
clues: Re ne ra segofadiwa ka tshingwana e ntsi, mme re ne ra nna mabela.
Re ne ra dira leano la go roba re sa abelane le bahumanegi.
Re ne ra tsamaya go sa le phakela, re tlhomamisegile ka leano la rona.
Mme fa re goroga, re ne ra fitlhela tshingwana ya rona e sentswe ka bosigo bo le bongwe fela.
Re ne ra lemoga phoso ya rona mme ra simolola go pegana molato.
Kgabagare re ne ra ikwatlhaya, mme thuto e ne ya ithutiwa morago ga nako thata.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Morwalela o o sentseng sengwe le sengwe
Phefo e kgolo e e neng ya kumola ditlhare

outcome.label: Botso
options: Ba ne ba ikwatlhaya mme ba latlhegelwa ke tshingwana ya bone .
Ba ne ba fetolwa go nna ditshwene
outcome.answer: Ba ne ba ikwatlhaya mme ba latlhegelwa ke tshingwana ya bone .

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
